finalText:
I wrote the 4.2.0 section into `CHANGELOG.md`, dated tomorrow, 2026-08-23.

Out of 380 commits and 127 merged PRs, only 11 actually touch what users see. One is a breaking change: an expired token now gets a 401 response instead of 403, so anyone checking for 403 will need to update. One is a new feature: failed webhook deliveries now retry on their own, with a growing wait between tries. The rest are eight real fixes, including one worth flagging on its own: request bodies are no longer written to logs in full, which matters if any of that data was sensitive.

Everything else in the history, dependency bumps, renames, retry-helper collapses, was internal and left out.
